summary: sales_lines view + 7 raw tables, data 2022-05-30 to 2025-06-29
1 unusual run(s) for revenue by total, period 2025-Q2: All 2025-06 low (peak $47,492 vs ~$4,019,480 expected)

result.answer:
Yes — June 2025 was unusual in last quarter, with a sharp companywide drop and Reseller sales disappearing entirely; the quarter is also incomplete because the data stops on 2025-06-29.

- Total revenue was unusually low in 2025-06 at $47,492 versus an expected ~$4,019,480, and total margin was also low at $26,540 versus an expected ~$592,182.
- By channel, Reseller had no sales at all in 2025-05 and 2025-06; Online carried the quarter, with revenue of $1,805,995 in April, $1,908,059 in May, then just $47,492 in June.
- The June drop was concentrated in Online; Reseller was already absent, so the unusual pattern is mainly a collapse in Online revenue and margin at month-end.
- I checked the month-by-channel trend in chart_9.
